mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it signals a strengthening labor market, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in residential sales signals a robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline and RSAFS increase) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >50% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the unemployment rate signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, the signal (UNRATE rise >0.2pp) fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the signal within the regime is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 115.0 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 115.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential sales above its 12-month moving average signals strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in >50% of instances when RSAFS > 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below its 3-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in residential sales signals a potential slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, the signal (RSAFS decline >1.0%) fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the signal within the regime is <0.03.
